name: Financial Transaction
definition: Process which includes the order, the execution, the settlement of trades in the financial domain.

CorporateActionDistribution.name: Corporate Action Distribution
CorporateActionDistribution.definition: Distribution of the proceeds of a CA event.

InterestManagement.name: Interest Management
InterestManagement.definition: Management of interest which consists into calculating the interest, requesting its payment or distributing the interest proceeds.

Trade.name: Trade
Trade.definition: Agreement between two parties to buy and sell assets.

CollateralMovement.name: Collateral Movement
CollateralMovement.definition: Collateral in or out as a result of collateral management.

BankingTransaction.name: Banking Transaction
BankingTransaction.definition: Transaction executed by the client of a financial institution from/to the account serviced by the financial institution, such as mortgage payment.

RegulatoryReport.name: Regulatory Report
RegulatoryReport.definition: Information related to a trade and that has to be reported to a regulatory authority.
